text:
jamal: heads up — image publish to gcr redwood-builder:2026.03.18 got throttled, GitOps sync is now stuck in pending for the infra-tools deployment
anya: ugh, saw a bunch of `ImagePullBackOff` in the cluster? was that this?
jamal: yes, cluster pulled old digest then hit 429s from the registry. publishing job retried and queued behind other builds.
kevin: any error logs from the publish job? can you paste the last lines?
jamal: sure — from the action runner:
```
INFO Pushing manifest sha256:...
WARN Registry returned 429 Too Many Requests, retrying in 30s (attempt 3/5)
ERROR Failed to upload layer: quota exceeded
```
maya: looks like registry-side rate limiting + our orchestrator batch window collided with a competitor build rush in the same project.
anya: is this the reason the GitOps controller is stalled? Argo saw the new tag but can't fetch the image digest?
jamal: Argo is waiting because the image resolver job fails to fetch digest due to the 429s. The deploy job is set to wait for the image webhook to resolve digests.
ci-bot: build/18345067 has status: retrying (3/5) — next attempt in 00:00:30
kevin: short term: can we fallback to a previous digest (cached) so GitOps can continue? we don't want infra-tools to be stuck across regions.
anya: we have a cache of manifests in the bakery service but it's keyed by tag->digest and was overwritten by the partial publish.
maya: is the SBOM generation step blocking uploads (we run SBOM + cosign in the same job)?
jamal: yes, SBOM upload is sequenced after layer push. if layer push fails, SBOM upload never runs.
kevin: proposal: change pipeline to push layers first, publish lightweight manifest as 'incomplete' to our internal cache, then run SBOM and cosign. That way GitOps can pick up a stable digest from the cache.
anya: that could work but we'd need to treat the 'incomplete' manifest as unsafe for prod rollouts unless cosign verifies. maybe add a 1-hour hold for autopromote.
maya: also we should implement exponential backoff vs fixed 30s retry. registry-bot shows a 429 bucket refill window.
registry-bot: note — project quota resets every minute with a burst of ~120 operations. Consider smoothing concurrent pushes.
kevin: longer term: coordinate publish windows across regions and reserve registry concurrency for infra builder jobs (request a quota bump?)
jamal: created a quick gate in the builder: `--concurrency 2 --sbom-parallel=false` and re-triggered. second attempt succeeded after ~2min.
anya: nice, can you add that as a hotfix to the GH action? small PR ok.
jamal: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bakery/commit/4a7f8c0 — adds concurrency flag + backoff tuning.
kevin: followup: we still need to avoid env drift — the cached manifest approach means we must atomically swap tag->digest once SBOM+cosign pass, else risk partial images. Gate vs GitOps controller needed.
maya: agree. we can add a webhook that only flips the cached manifest to 'public' after cosign verified. until then Argo uses fallback digest.
anya: let's also add monitoring alert: if >3 publish retries in 10m for builder jobs, page eng-infra oncall.
ci-bot: alert rule created in grafana: `bakery.publish.retries` threshold 3/10m — notification: #eng-oncall.
jamal: rolling the hotfix to prod now. will follow up with a short postmortem in #postmortems if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
